newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: New Austrian chancellor unveils cabinet.
newsitem.headline: New Austrian chancellor unveils cabinet.

text.p: Austrian chancellor-designate Viktor Klima unveiled his ministerial team on Monday after the ruling Social Democratic Party leadership unanimously approved his choice of cabinet.

Klima, making his first public appearance since agreeing to take over as chancellor from Franz Vranitzky, confirmed that Vienna city finance chief Rudolf Edlinger would take over the finance ministry and former state secretary for public works Karl Schloegl would inherit the job of interior minister.
Former interior minister Caspar Einem, whose reputation suffered last year after it emerged he had made a donation to a radical left-wing newsletter, will move to transport.
"This is a team for the future," Klima told a news conference.
Vranitzky's surprise resignation as chancellor and party leader on January 18 triggered the shake-up.
President Thomas Klestil will swear in the new cabinet on Tuesday. There will be no changes to posts held by junior coalition partner the conservative People's Party.
"I hope that (the coalition parties) will work together on a fair basis," Klima said.
